title: AllThatData
tagline: AllThat Data is reinventing COLLABORATION in the most SECURE way!
description:
AllThatData provides decentralized storage of an organization's data.

It provides Access Control to the files as per the defined roles.

And it provides Collaboration for data stored on the blockchain – thus leveraging security + speed.

𝗙𝘂𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘀

Create in-built text editors to provide easy access and edit options - to work with the text directly

Make more file types compatible with the platform

Provide more Access Control features for the data stored on the platform

Improve the way the members communicate with each other in the platform
how_its_made:
Our Smart Contract is built with 𝗦𝗼𝗹𝗶𝗱𝗶𝘁𝘆 and deployed on 𝗙𝗘𝗩𝗠. The smart contract lets you create a profile of your organization and add details around it. 

You can add different members to the organization, where members can have roles like HR, Admin, Finance, etc.

What data you can access and the levels of permission are defined as per your role.
